features: HIGH-PERFORMANCE COPPER CLAD ALUMINUM (CCA) - Unleash unmatched performance with our primary wiring cable. Its unique composition boasts higher copper content for exceptional conductivity and electrical prowess. The significantly thicker copper coating, unlike regular CCA wires, combines the advantages of aluminum's resilience with copper's conductivity, ensuring peak performance and cost efficiency. The ultimate market choice!

100ft ROLL OF INDIVIDUAL SINGLE-CONDUCTOR WIRE - Presented in a convenient roll, this wire extends up to 100ft in length. With one roll featuring red wire and another housing black wire, each individual conductor is meticulously designed to cater to a multitude of applications. Whether for primary wiring, remote connections, turn-on mechanisms, hook-ups, or grounding needs, these wires can be customized to suit your specific project requirements.

DURABLE PVC JACKET - Crafted with premium materials, our wire features a robust PVC jacket that enhances its strength and resilience. This protective jacket safeguards the wire from impacts and abrasion while retaining flexibility for effortless installation across diverse applications.

OPTIMAL 14-GAUGE STRANDED DESIGN - Engineered with a stranded configuration and precisely calibrated 14-gauge thickness, our wire guarantees unmatched conductivity and minimal signal interference. This premium wire is exceptionally well-suited for a diverse range of 12-volt applications, solidifying its excellence for any electrical endeavor.

WIDE COMPATIBILITY - Our wiring solutions exhibit remarkable versatility, catering to various applications like primary/remote, power/ground, trailer/automotive, speaker, and general electrical needs. Choose from 10, 12, 14, 16, and 18 gauge options in diverse colors (black, red, blue, yellow, white, green, brown, orange, purple, pink, and gray). Available in lengths ranging from 25ft to 500ft, perfectly fitting your project requirements.
